items.headline: France vs. Spain Set for Epic Semi-Final
items.body: France will face Spain in a highly anticipated World Cup 2026 semi-final on July 14. The match, kicking off at 19:00 UTC, will be held at AT&T Stadium in Arlington, Texas. Both teams have shown formidable form throughout the tournament, setting the stage for a thrilling encounter.

items.headline: Spain Edges Belgium in Quarter-Final Thriller
items.body: Spain secured their semi-final spot by defeating Belgium 2-1 in a hard-fought quarter-final match at SoFi Stadium in Los Angeles. Fabián Ruiz scored in the first half, with Mikel Merino sealing the victory in the 87th minute.

items.headline: France Dominates Morocco to Advance
items.body: France booked their place in the semi-finals with a convincing 2-0 victory over Morocco in their quarter-final clash. Goals from Kylian Mbappé in the 60th minute and Ousmane Dembélé six minutes later ensured France's progression.

items.headline: Mbappé Leads Golden Boot Race
items.body: Kylian Mbappé continues his sensational form, leading the tournament's scoring charts with eight goals. His consistent performance has been crucial to France's dominant run to the semi-finals.

items.headline: Merino's Clutch Performances for Spain
items.body: Mikel Merino has emerged as a pivotal player for Spain in the knockout stages, delivering crucial goals against both Portugal and Belgium. His timely contributions have been instrumental in Spain's progression.

items.headline: France's Unstoppable Offensive Power
items.body: France enters the semi-finals as the highest-scoring team of the tournament, demonstrating exceptional attacking prowess. They dominated their group with a perfect nine points and a +8 goal difference, continuing their strong form into the knockout rounds.

items.headline: Spain's Impregnable Defense
items.body: Spain has showcased an impressive defensive record, topping their group with seven points and conceding zero goals. Their ability to shut down opponents has been a cornerstone of their successful campaign.
